Name: Simple Pouch
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Pouch gives your farmer a separate storage panel beside the backpack. It starts with 12 slots and can be upgraded to 60 without changing your backpack or taking up one of its slots. The interface uses Stardew Valley’s familiar colours, borders, and fonts.
Join the Adventurer’s Guild and reach mine floor 20. After you leave the mines, Marlon will send a letter the next morning inviting you to collect your pouch for free. Empty it before taking it to Clint for an upgrade.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Pouch.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]SimplePouch[/code]folder in your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]If you previously used [b]Simple Pockets[/b], remove its old mod folder before installing Simple Pouch. Your saved pouch contents and upgrades will carry over.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Upgrade from 12 to 24, 36, 48, and finally 60 slots.[/*]
[*]Open the pouch beside your backpack and keep Tab’s normal backpack behaviour.[/*]
[*]Organise items, mark favourites, and deposit matching backpack items.[/*]
[*]Use pouch ingredients for crafting and cooking.[/*]
[*]Enable auto-pickup if you want it. It starts [b]off[/b], and its pickup filter starts at [b]All items[/b].[/*]
[*]Play in any of Stardew Valley’s 12 built-in languages.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Better Crafting and Simple Tool Delivery have optional integrations; neither is required. Everyone in a multiplayer game should install the same version of Simple Pouch.
